 Coram : Neeraj P. Dhote, J.
 Date : 10.09.2025

Per Court :
1.

This is an Application under Section 482 of the Bharatiya
Nyaya Sanhita Act, 2023 [hereinafter referred to as 'Bns'] for
Anticipatory Bail in Crime No.259/2025 registered with Udgir City
Police Station, District Latur for the offence punishable under Sections
123, 223, 274, 275 of Bns and Section 59 of the Food Safety and
Standards Act, 2006.
2.  The case of Prosecution, in brief, is that, the Police received secret information that, the Gutka Pan Masala was being transported in one vehicle and accordingly, a trap was laid.
The Gutka Pan Masala worth Rs.2,61,100/- came to be seized from a rickshaw.
At the instance of the auto rickshaw Driver, the Police went to one house from where the Gutka Pan Masala worth Rs.43,716/- came to be seized.
From Accused No.2, the Police learnt that, the said articles belong to the Applicant.
3. The Applicant is running a tea stall.
The only non  offence is Section 123 of BNS.

sentences.text: Rest o  Sections are bailable.
The Applicant is named by the Co-accused.
In  this view of the matter, prima facie case for interim protection is  out.

Hence, the following order:
 ORDER [I] In the event of arrest of the Applicant in connection with Crime No.259/2025 registered with Udgir City Police Station, District Latur for the offence punishable under Sections 123, 223, 274, 275 of BNS and Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, he be released on bail on his furnishing P.B. of Rs.15,000/- [Rupees Fifteen Thousand] with one surety in the like amount.
